title: lithocarpus leptogyne
intro: Lithocarpus leptogyne, commonly known as the Taiwan walnut, is a species of evergreen tree in the beech family (Fagaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the potential to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus leptogyne are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-hyperlipidemic agent, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus leptogyne include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
